scoped_assurance.authority_headline: Immediate bounded rate changes · governance delayed
findings: Eligible SPBEAM rate changes execute immediately within a 16-hour cooldown, 200–3,000 bps SSR range and 400 bps step limit. The known governance path is separately delayed. Full wards can set rates beyond SPBEAM bounds and reach upgrades. Complete ward coverage, signer independence and alternate fast full-reach paths remain unverified.

Ethereum implementation 0x4e7991e5c547ce825bdEb665EE14a3274f9F61e0 matched verified runtime. SUsds.sol matches ChainSecurity L1 audit revision e5660deac9434c79d48ecde879c29f37fb89f2dc, including the permit fix. Cantina covers a distinct L2 token without savings logic.

Immunefi explicitly lists sUSDS, with up to $10 million for qualifying critical impacts. Pinned tests and specifications cover accrual, upgrades, previews and redemption. Installed-build test receipts, formal proofs and implementation-specific payouts remain unverified.
